description: This file defines a final class 'ConsoleEvents' which contains constants representing various event names used within the Goteo project's console module. These event names relate to project lifecycle events, refund processes, mailing activities, and other campaign-related actions, serving as identifiers for event handling in an event-driven architecture.

classes.name: ConsoleEvents
classes.description: A final class containing string constants that define event names for console-related actions in the Goteo platform.
